preset-help: Starting points for different travelers and decision makers. Move any slider to make it your own.
weights-help: How much each kind of feature or problem moves a street's score. The bar under each slider shows its average effect right now.
severity-help: At 100% a severe problem counts more than a minor one, as the engine does. At 0% every problem counts the same.
tags: Use tag adjustments (e.g. a curb ramp tagged steep counts less)
min-completion: Minimum completion to show a score
min-completion-help: Neighborhoods explored less than this are hatched instead of scored, so a score never rests on a few streets.
updated-at: Scores reflect labels clustered on {{date}}. Labels added since then are folded in nightly.
updated-never: Scores will appear after the first nightly clustering run.
view-labelmap: See the labels on the Label Map
